lines.trans: There is a crowd of guys standing in the back courtyard.
It seems your father called them there.
And right now he led your boyfriend out there.
I do not like the sound of this at all!
Guys, let's all follow me quickly!
Ninety thousand, and you took ten this afternoon.
Wait, I will recount all the money right now.
Ainura, have you seen my father?
I saw him, he just went into the office.
A young guy in a leather jacket with a skull was with him.
A real pirate, probably, be careful!
I will find them right now, wait here.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'there', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Это настоящий успех!
examples.trans: This is real success!

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'pirate' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Настоящий пират, наверное, будь осторожна!
examples.trans: A real pirate, probably, be careful!

examples.text: На кухне ресторана всегда есть пират.
examples.trans: In the restaurant kitchen there is always pirate.

meanings.note: Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'верное').

examples.text: Давление, наверное, может, я дома отлежусь?
examples.trans: It is probably blood pressure, maybe I can rest at home?

examples.text: Алло, скорая, тут человеку плохо, аппендицит, наверное!
examples.trans: Hello, ambulance, someone is sick here, probably appendicitis!

examples.text: Настоящий пират, наверное, будь осторожна!
examples.trans: A real pirate, probably, be careful!

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'were he'.

examples.text: Может быть, нам лучше полицию вызвать?
examples.trans: Maybe we had better call the police?

examples.text: Вы так сильно хотите быть вместе.
examples.trans: You want to be together so badly.

examples.text: У меня есть машинка.
examples.trans: I have a toy car.

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('cautious').

examples.text: Настоящий пират, наверное, будь осторожна!
examples.trans: A real pirate, probably, be careful!

examples.text: Будьте осторожны.
examples.trans: Be careful.

examples.text: Он осторожный человек.
examples.trans: He is a cautious person.

meanings.note: Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'will find', paired with 'находить'.

examples.text: Лёва, пожалуйста, даже не начинай.
examples.trans: Lyova, please, do not even start.

examples.text: Я сейчас найду их, подождите здесь.
examples.trans: I will find them right now, wait here.

examples.text: Где я найду грузчиков?
examples.trans: Where will I find movers?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'here', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Здесь вообще-то люди ходят.
examples.trans: People actually walk through here.

examples.text: Понял, а сколько здесь денег?
examples.trans: Got it, and how much money is here?

examples.text: Здесь ровно сто тысяч рублей.
examples.trans: There is exactly one hundred thousand rubles here.
